name: smwmusic-new-super-mario-bros-mega-mushroom
title: New Super Mario Bros. - Mega Mushroom
description:
A port of the "Mega Mushroom" from New Super Mario Bros.
This could work well as a boss theme, since it can't be used as the "Starman" theme due to being sampled.

Update:
-Further optimized: reduced from 0x0532 to 0x04E6.
-Replaced the sample used in channels 3, 4, and 7.
-Includes a version with echo (0x04F7) and another without echo.
